data.name: BotConfiguration_ProofOfConceptAccounts_Description
data.value: Comma separated login names of existing accounts to animate as bots, in addition to the generated population.

data.name: BotSelfDefensePlugIn_Description
data.value: Makes server-side bots fight back when a player attacks them.

data.name: BotRevengePlugIn_Description
data.value: Makes server-side bots return to their death site and take revenge on the player who killed them.

data.name: BotSkillProgressionPlugIn_Description
data.value: Invests level-up stat points and teaches server-side bots new class- and level-appropriate skills as they level up.

data.name: BotFeaturePlugIn_Description
data.value: Spawns server-side bots which hunt monsters on the maps. Configure the accounts to animate and enable the feature.

data.name: MaximumConnectionsPerIpPlugIn_Description
data.value: Limits the maximum number of parallel connections from the same IP address.

data.name: LoginTimeoutPlugIn_Description
data.value: Disconnects clients which don't log in within the configured time after they connected.

data.name: SpeedHackDetectPlugIn_Description
data.value: Detects and prevents player walk and attack speedhacking.

data.name: KanturuGatewayPlugIn_Description
data.value: Handles the Kanturu Gateway Machine NPC for event entry.

data.name: SymbolOfKundunStackedPlugIn_Description
data.value: This plugin transforms a stack of symbol of kundun into a lost map.

data.name: DuelSpawnGatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Spawns a player which is in a duel at its side of the duel area.

data.name: SoccerSpawnGatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Spawns a player of a running soccer match on the soccer ground.

data.name: PetExperiencePlugIn_Description
data.value: Gives the trainable pets of a player a share of the experience which the player gained for a kill.

data.name: WhiteWizardInvasionPlugIn_Description
data.value: Enables the White Wizard Invasion feature.

data.name: ItemRegistrationConfiguration_Rules_Description
data.value: Configure item registration rules for different NPCs.

data.name: NpcItemRegistrationRule_NpcNumber_Description
data.value: The NPC definition number (e.g. 236 for Golden Archer).

data.name: NpcItemRegistrationRule_AcceptedItemGroup_Description
data.value: Group of the accepted item (e.g. 14 for event items).

data.name: NpcItemRegistrationRule_AcceptedItemNumber_Description
data.value: Number of the accepted item (e.g. 21 for Rena).

data.name: NpcItemRegistrationRule_RequiredItemsCount_Description
data.value: Number of items required to receive a reward.

data.name: NpcItemRegistrationRule_RewardZen_Description
data.value: Zen awarded upon reaching the required item count.

data.name: NpcItemRegistrationRule_RewardDropItemGroup_Description
data.value: The DropItemGroup used to generate the item reward drop. If empty, no item drops (Zen reward only).

data.name: PKClearConfiguration_ZenCostPerKill_Description
data.value: The amount of Zen required to clear one PK count.

data.name: PKClearConfiguration_AllowRegularPlayers_Description
data.value: Allows regular players to use this command to clear their own PK status for Zen.

data.name: LostMapDroppedPlugIn_Description
data.value: This plugin handles the drop of the lost map item. It creates the gate to the kalima map.

data.name: ItemBoxDroppedPlugIn_Description
data.value: This plugin handles the drop of an item box, e.g. box of kundun.

data.name: ActorHitRecorderPlugIn_Description
data.value: Records hits dealt and received by scripted test actors in their event stream.

data.name: SpeedHackDetectConfiguration_SkillHitCounterReplayWindowMs_Caption
data.value: Skill Hit Counter Replay Window Ms

data.name: SpeedHackDetectConfiguration_SkillHitMaxAreaToHitDelaySeconds_Caption
data.value: Skill Hit Max Area To Hit Delay Seconds

data.name: SpeedHackDetectConfiguration_AttackSpeedProfiles_Description
data.value: Optional overrides for individual skills. A profile replaces the common attack or magic speed settings for its skill.

data.name: AttackSpeedProfile_SpeedSource_Description
data.value: Which speed attribute scales the delay: Attack Speed for physical skills, Magic Speed for wizardry and curse skills.

data.name: RaklionPlugIn_Description
data.value: The event in the hatchery of raklion: when all spider eggs are destroyed, Selupan appears. After the battle, the hatchery is closed for some time.

data.name: CrywolfPlugIn_Description
data.value: The event in the crywolf fortress: the players defend the statue of the holy wolf against the army of Balgass. The result is kept until the next event.

data.name: CrywolfChatCommandPlugIn_Description
data.value: Lets the crywolf event proceed: it starts the event when it is not running, and during the battle Balgass appears if he did not yet. Otherwise, the current state ends.

data.name: ImperialGuardianFeaturePlugIn_Description
data.value: Configures the run of the imperial guardian event, e.g. its times, the experience reward and the scaling of the monsters.

data.name: SuspiciousScrapOfPaperStackedPlugIn_Name
data.value: Suspicious scrap of paper stack transformation

data.name: SuspiciousScrapOfPaperStackedPlugIn_Description
data.value: Transforms a full stack of suspicious scraps of paper into a Gaion's Order.

data.name: GensFeaturePlugIn_Description
data.value: Configures the gens system, in which the players can join one of the gens Duprian and Vanert at their npcs.

data.name: GensMembershipPlugIn_Description
data.value: Loads the gens membership of a character when it enters the game, and shows it to the player.

data.name: GensBattleZonePlugIn_Description
data.value: Only gens members can enter the battle zone. Kills between the members of different gens in it change their contribution points, without making the killer an outlaw.

data.name: GensRankingPlugIn_Description
data.value: Calculates the ranking of the gens in the configured interval, and updates the ranking positions and ranks of all members.

data.name: GensRelationshipRulesPlugIn_Description
data.value: The rules of the gens for parties, guilds and alliances: no party between different gens and in the battle zone, guilds and alliances only within a gens.

data.name: KalimaTicketConsumeHandlerPlugIn_Description
data.value: Opens a gate to the level of Kalima which fits the level of the character. Each use takes one of the ticket's usages.

data.name: KalimaTicketConsumeHandlerConfiguration_MinimumLevels_Name
data.value: Minimum levels of the Kalima levels

data.name: KalimaTicketConsumeHandlerConfiguration_SpecialCharacterMinimumLevels_Name
data.value: Minimum levels of the Kalima levels for special characters

data.name: BloodCastleArchangelTalkPlugIn_Description
data.value: Handles talking to the Archangel in the blood castle event, where players hand in the quest item to win the event.

data.name: IllusionTempleStoneStatueTalkPlugIn_Description
data.value: Handles talking to the Stone Statue in the illusion temple event, where players pick up the sacred relic.

data.name: IllusionTempleAllianceStorageTalkPlugIn_Description
data.value: Handles talking to the Alliance Item Storage in the illusion temple event, to which the allied forces carry the sacred relic to score a point.

data.name: IllusionTempleIllusionStorageTalkPlugIn_Description
data.value: Handles talking to the Illusion Item Storage in the illusion temple event, to which the illusion forces carry the sacred relic to score a point.

data.name: NpcTalkPlugInConfiguration_Npc_Description
data.value: The NPC which is handled by this plugin. If no NPC is set, the plugin doesn't handle any NPC.

data.name: TwisterAnimationCounterStrategy_Description
data.value: Describes how the game client counts the animations of Twister: every animation is counted, and the hits don't contain the animation counter.

data.name: EvilSpiritAnimationCounterStrategy_Description
data.value: Describes how the game client counts the animations of Evil Spirit: every animation is counted.

data.name: MultiShotAnimationCounterStrategy_Description
data.value: Describes how the game client counts the animations of Multi-Shot: the hits don't contain the animation counter.

data.name: LostConnectionDetectionPlugIn_Description
data.value: Disconnects players whose client stopped to report that it's alive, because their connection got lost without being closed. Otherwise, they would stay connected, and further logins of their account would be rejected.

data.name: LostConnectionDetectionConfiguration_Timeout_Description
data.value: The time after which a connection is considered lost, when its client didn't report that it's alive. The game client reports it every 20 seconds. Zero disables the detection.

data.name: CashShopVersionPlugIn_Description
data.value: Sends the versions of the cash shop script and banner to the player when it enters the game.

data.name: CashShopFeaturePlugIn_Description
data.value: The in-game cash shop. When it's deactivated, the cash shop can't be opened. Its configuration holds the settings, e.g. about gifts and the storage size.

data.name: GoblinPointsForPlayTimePlugIn_Description
data.value: Gives players Goblin Points of the cash shop for their play time.

data.name: VaultExtensionDeliveryPlugIn_Description
data.value: Extends the vault of the account when a player uses the Vault Expansion Certificate from the cash shop storage.

data.name: InventoryExtensionDeliveryPlugIn_Description
data.value: Adds an inventory extension to the character when a player uses the Magic Backpack from the cash shop storage.

data.name: SummonerCharacterCardDeliveryPlugIn_Description
data.value: Unlocks the Summoner class for the account when a player uses the Summoner Character Card from the cash shop storage.

data.name: RageFighterCharacterCardDeliveryPlugIn_Name
data.value: Cash shop: Rage Fighter Character Card

data.name: RageFighterCharacterCardDeliveryPlugIn_Description
data.value: Unlocks the Rage Fighter class for the account when a player uses the Rage Fighter Character Card from the cash shop storage.

data.name: GameEventPublisherPlugIn_Description
data.value: Publishes events of the game, like mini games, invasions, castle siege state changes and rare item drops, to the whole server, e.g. for a Discord integration.

data.name: GameEventPublisherConfiguration_PublishGlobalNotices_Name
data.value: Publish global notices of game masters

data.name: PlayerShopCurrenciesFeaturePlugIn_Description
data.value: Allows players to set the prices of the items in their personal store in configured items like jewels, or in account coins, too. Only the open source client shows these prices; with other clients, they can be set by chat command.

data.name: ShowShopCurrenciesAfterEnterWorldPlugIn_Name
data.value: Show player shop currencies after entering the game

data.name: ShowShopCurrenciesAfterEnterWorldPlugIn_Description
data.value: Tells the client which currencies can be used for the prices of personal stores, when the player enters the game.

data.name: ShopPriceChatCommandPlugIn_Description
data.value: Sets the price of an item of the own personal store in one of the enabled currencies, e.g. '/shopprice 1 10 bless'. Without arguments, it lists the prices.

data.name: ServerAnnouncementsPlugIn_Description
data.value: Shows a configured list of announcements to all players of a game server, one after another in a fixed interval.

data.name: ServerAnnouncementsConfiguration_Interval_Description
data.value: The time between one announcement and the next. The minimum is 10 seconds.

data.name: ServerAnnouncementsConfiguration_Messages_Description
data.value: The announcements, in the order in which they are shown. After the last one, it starts over with the first one.

data.name: ServerAnnouncementsConfiguration_Type_Description
data.value: How the announcement is shown, e.g. as golden message in the center of the screen or as blue system message.

data.name: CastleSiegeRegistrationGuardsmanTalkPlugIn_Description
data.value: Opens the Castle Siege registration window, which shows the Castle Siege status, when a player talks to a guardsman on the Castle Siege map.

data.name: CastleSiegeGuardsmanTalkPlugIn_Description
data.value: Shows Land of Trials availability and its applicable entry fee.

data.name: DiscordChatCommandPlugIn_Description
data.value: Links the account to a Discord user: '/discord link' creates a code which is entered in Discord, '/discord unlink' removes the link, '/discord notify letter' turns direct messages about letters on or off (also 'login' and 'friend').

data.name: WorldChatChatCommandPlugIn_Description
data.value: Sends a message to the world chat, which all players of all game servers can read, e.g. '/world Hello!'. It can be bridged to Discord.

data.name: GameEventPublisherConfiguration_PublishChatMessages_Name
data.value: Publish guild, alliance and world chat

data.name: GuildChatBridgeNoticePlugIn_Description
data.value: Tells players when they enter the game, if the chat of their guild or alliance is mirrored to Discord.

data.name: DiscordIntegrationFeaturePlugIn_Description
data.value: Tells game clients which ask for it how the server is connected to Discord (invite link, Rich Presence application, account link, mirrored chats), lets players link their account from the client, and sends them messages written in Discord as such.

data.name: EliteHealingPotionConsumeHandlerPlugIn_Description
data.value: Plugin which handles the elite healing potion consumption. It recovers the health immediately.

data.name: EliteManaPotionConsumeHandlerPlugIn_Description
data.value: Plugin which handles the elite mana potion consumption. It recovers the mana immediately.

data.name: EliteShieldPotionConsumeHandlerPlugIn_Description
data.value: Plugin which handles the elite SD potion consumption. It recovers the shield immediately.

data.name: MediumEliteHealingPotionConsumeHandlerPlugIn_Name
data.value: Medium Elite Healing Potion Consume Handler

data.name: MediumEliteHealingPotionConsumeHandlerPlugIn_Description
data.value: Plugin which handles the medium elite healing potion consumption. It recovers a part of the health immediately.

data.name: ItemUpgradeConfiguration_OptionType_Description
data.value: The type of the item option which is upgraded: the normal option for the Jewel of Life, the harmony option for the Jewel of Harmony and the refine stones.

data.name: ItemUpgradeConfiguration_AddsOption_Description
data.value: Whether an item which doesn't have the option yet can get it by consuming the source item.

data.name: ItemUpgradeConfiguration_IncreasesOption_Description
data.value: Whether the level of an existing option of the item can be increased.

data.name: ItemUpgradeConfiguration_SuccessChance_Description
data.value: The chance between 0 and 1 that an attempt succeeds. The Jewel of Life uses 0.5.

data.name: ItemUpgradeConfiguration_FailResult_Description
data.value: What happens to the option when the random check fails: nothing, the option is set back to its base level, or the option is removed.

data.name: ItemUpgradeConfiguration_BoostOptionType_Description
data.value: An item option of the target item which increases the success chance, e.g. the luck option.

data.name: ItemUpgradeConfiguration_SuccessChanceBoost_Description
data.value: The additional success chance when the target item has the boost option type.

data.name: SantaVillageInvitationConsumeHandlerPlugIn_Name
data.value: Invitation to Santa Village Consume Handler

data.name: SantaVillageInvitationConsumeHandlerPlugIn_Description
data.value: Plugin which handles the invitation to the santa village, which warps the player to the santa village.

data.name: BotConfiguration_MapsForbiddenForBots_Description
data.value: Maps bots never warp to: no hunting, following or events there, and a bot which logs in on one leaves it. Players are not affected.

data.name: BotChatPlugIn_Description
data.value: Lets server-side bots talk: they announce events and invasions with /post, comment on level milestones and answer whispers, using configurable lines.

data.name: BotChatLine_Text_Description
data.value: What the bot says. The placeholders in curly braces which the list offers are filled in - see the description of the list.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_EventPostChancePercent_Description
data.value: Chance that a bot which meets the entry requirements announces an opened Blood Castle, Devil Square or Chaos Castle with /post. Rolled once per event type and opening. 0 = never.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_InvasionPostChancePercent_Description
data.value: Chance that a bot which may warp to the invaded map announces a started invasion with /post. 0 = never.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_MinTimeBetweenPosts_Description
data.value: Minimum time between two /post messages of bots on one game server.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_MaxPostDelay_Description
data.value: A bot waits a random time up to this value before it posts about an event.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_LevelMilestoneStep_Description
data.value: Every how many levels a bot may comment on its level-up. 0 = never.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_LevelMilestoneChancePercent_Description
data.value: Chance that a bot comments on reaching a level milestone, in the normal chat.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_BotChatCooldown_Description
data.value: Minimum time between two normal chat lines of the same bot.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_WhisperReplyChancePercent_Description
data.value: Chance that a bot answers a whisper of a player. 0 = never.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_WhisperReplyCooldown_Description
data.value: Minimum time between two whisper replies of the same bot.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_GreetingChancePercent_Description
data.value: Chance that the nearest bot greets a player who enters the game, in the normal chat. 0 = never.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_GreetingCooldown_Description
data.value: Minimum time between two greetings of the same player, so logging out and in again doesn't start a round of greetings.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_PartyChatChancePercent_Description
data.value: Chance that a bot says something in the party chat of a player: thanks for the invitation, "gg" after an event. 0 = never.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_KilledByPlayerChancePercent_Description
data.value: Chance that a bot killed by a player (outside of an event) says something about it in the normal chat, before it respawns. 0 = never.

data.name: BotChatReply_Keywords_Description
data.value: Comma-separated words or phrases of a player's message which this reply answers, e.g. "how are you, how r u". Whole words, case and punctuation are ignored. Replies without keywords are used when nothing matches.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_EventLines_Description
data.value: Posted with /post when the entrance of a Blood Castle, Devil Square or Chaos Castle opened; the bot then waits for players at the meeting point. Placeholders: {event}, {map} (the meeting point), {location} (the meeting point with coordinates), {level}.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_InvasionLines_Description
data.value: Posted with /post when an invasion started. Placeholders: {event}, {map}, {location} (the map alone), {level}.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_LevelMilestoneLines_Description
data.value: Said in the normal chat when the bot reached a level milestone. Placeholders: {level}, {map}, {location} (the bot's map and coordinates, e.g. "Devias 215, 40").

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_WhisperReplies_Description
data.value: Answers to a player who whispered to the bot or mentioned its name in the normal chat next to it. The best keyword match wins; replies without keywords are the fallback. Placeholders: {player}, {level}, {map}, {location} (the bot's map and coordinates, e.g. "Devias 215, 40"), {wings} (the bot's wings; a bot without wings answers with one of the answers without wings).

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_GreetingLines_Description
data.value: Said by the nearest bot in the normal chat when a player entered the game. Placeholders: {player}, {level}, {map}, {location} (the bot's map and coordinates, e.g. "Devias 215, 40").

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_PartyJoinedLines_Description
data.value: Said in the party chat after the bot accepted a player's invitation. Placeholders: {player} (the inviter), {level}, {map}, {location} (the bot's map and coordinates, e.g. "Devias 215, 40").

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_EventFinishedLines_Description
data.value: Said in the party chat by one bot per party when an event it went through with a player's party ended. Placeholders: {event}, {level}.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_KilledLines_Description
data.value: Said in the normal chat when a player killed the bot outside of an event. Placeholders: {player} (the killer), {level}, {map}, {location} (the bot's map and coordinates, e.g. "Devias 215, 40").

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_KilledAgainLines_Description
data.value: Said instead of the "Killed by a player" lines when the same player killed the bot again within a short time. Placeholders: {player}, {level}, {map}, {location}.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_PartyVolunteerCount_Description
data.value: How many bots whisper to a player who searches party members with /post, e.g. "/post party 300-350 bk dw". The same search posted again is answered by other bots. 0 = off.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_PartyRequestKeywords_Description
data.value: Comma-separated words which mark a /post as a party search. The post also needs a level: "300-350", "300+", "min 300" or "300" - or an event with its level, like "bc7".

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_PartyBloodCastleKeywords_Description
data.value: Comma-separated words for the Blood Castle in a party search. Followed by the event level, like "party bc7", they call the bots which may enter that Blood Castle.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_PartyDevilSquareKeywords_Description
data.value: Comma-separated words for the Devil Square in a party search. Followed by the event level, like "party ds5", they call the bots which may enter that Devil Square.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_PartyChaosCastleKeywords_Description
data.value: Comma-separated words for the Chaos Castle in a party search. Followed by the event level, like "party cc3", they call the bots which may enter that Chaos Castle.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_PartyHereKeywords_Description
data.value: Comma-separated words with which the player tells an answering bot to come to where the player stands, instead of naming a map and coordinates.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_PartyOfferTimeout_Description
data.value: How long a bot which answered a party search waits for the player to whisper back where to meet, e.g. "devias 215 40".

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_PartyMeetingWaitTime_Description
data.value: How long a bot waits at the meeting place for the party invitation before it goes back to hunting.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_PartyVolunteerLines_Description
data.value: Whispered to a player whose party search the bot answers. Placeholders: {player}, {level}, {class}, {map}, {location}.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_PartyAskWhereLines_Description
data.value: Whispered when the bot didn't understand where to meet. Placeholders: {player}, {level}, {class}.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_PartyOnTheWayLines_Description
data.value: Whispered when the bot sets off to the meeting place. Placeholders: {player}, {map} and {location} (the meeting place).

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_PartyCantGoLines_Description
data.value: Whispered when the bot may not go to the named map: its level is too low, or the map can't be reached by warp. Placeholders: {player}, {map} (the named map), {level}.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_PartyClassAliases_Description
data.value: The words players use for the character classes in a party search, e.g. "dk, bk, bm". The class number stands for its whole line of classes.

data.name: BotClassAlias_Keywords_Description
data.value: Comma-separated words for the class line, e.g. "dk, bk, bm, knight". Whole words, case and punctuation are ignored.

data.name: BotClassAlias_ClassNumber_Description
data.value: The number of a character class of the line, e.g. 4 for the Dark Knight - the whole line (Dark Knight, Blade Knight, Blade Master) is meant.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_ConversationInterval_Description
data.value: How often a player may overhear two bots near them talking. Counts per player: everyone who stands next to two bots hears them talk about once per interval.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_ConversationChancePercent_Description
data.value: Chance that two bots near a player talk when the interval is over. 0 = never.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_Conversations_Description
data.value: Exchanges of two bots near a player, like the townsfolk of a role-playing game: one says the opener, the other answers. Drawn without repetition. Placeholders: {map}, {location}, {level}, {class} of the speaking bot, {partner} (the other bot).

data.name: BotConversation_Reply_Description
data.value: What the second bot answers, a few seconds later.

data.name: BotConversation_Where_Description
data.value: Where the bots may have this conversation: Town (both in a safezone), Hunting (both outside of it) or Anywhere.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_MerchantTalkInterval_Description
data.value: How often a bot standing in a safezone may advertise like a merchant, per game server. Only when a player sees it.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_MerchantTalkChancePercent_Description
data.value: Chance that a bot advertises when the interval is over. 0 (default) = never: the lines are meant for a future merchant bot.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_MerchantLines_Description
data.value: Said now and then in the normal chat by a bot standing in a safezone, like a merchant advertising. Off by default. Placeholders: {level}, {map}, {location}.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_CongratulationChancePercent_Description
data.value: Chance that the nearest bot congratulates a player on a level-up or a reset in the normal chat ("gz"). 0 = never.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_CongratulationCooldown_Description
data.value: Minimum time between two congratulations of the same player on a level-up (and, separately, on a reset).

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_CongratulationLines_Description
data.value: Said by the nearest bot when a player leveled up. Placeholders: {player}, {level} and {resets} of the player, {map}.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_ResetCongratulationLines_Description
data.value: Said by the nearest bot when a player made a reset. Placeholders: {player}, {level} and {resets} of the player, {map}.

data.name: BotChatLine_When_Description
data.value: When it may be said, by the local time of the server: Anytime, Morning (5-11), Day (11-18), Evening (18-23) or Night (23-5).

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_DeclineReplyChancePercent_Description
data.value: Chance that a bot says why it turns down a trade or duel request, by whisper. It turns them down in any case: a bot has no trade window and doesn't duel.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_TradeDeclineLines_Description
data.value: Whispered when a player asks the bot for a trade. Placeholders: {player}, {level}, {map}, {location}.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_DuelDeclineLines_Description
data.value: Whispered when a player challenges the bot to a duel. Placeholders: {player}, {level}, {map}, {location}.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_BusyChatMessageCount_Description
data.value: From how many normal chat messages of players near a bot (within the time below) the bot says nothing unasked - no conversations, greetings, congratulations or comments. Answers to a player stay. 0 = off.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_BusyChatWindow_Description
data.value: How long a message of a player counts for the setting above.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_MessageLanguages_Description
data.value: Typical words and letters by which a bot recognizes the language of a player's message: it answers in that language, even when the player's account language is another one. A message which doesn't tell is answered in the player's own language.

data.name: BotChatLanguageHint_Words_Description
data.value: Comma-separated typical words of the language. The language with the most hits in a message wins; a tie leaves it open.

data.name: BotChatLanguageHint_Letters_Description
data.value: Letters only this language uses, e.g. ąćęłńóśźż. One of them in a message counts like a typical word.

data.name: BotChatLine_Gesture_Description
data.value: A gesture the bot makes with it, like a player typing /hello: Greeting, Goodbye, Clap, Cheer, Win, Smile, Respect, Salute, Cry, Awkward or Provocation. The bot turns to the player it talks to.

data.name: BotConversation_Riposte_Description
data.value: What the first bot says back to the reply, a few seconds later. Empty for a conversation of two lines.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_ConversationJoinLines_Description
data.value: Said by one of two bots when a player near them writes in the normal chat right after their conversation - unless the message matches a whisper reply keyword. Placeholders: {player}, {map}, {level}, {class}.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_EventReminderChancePercent_Description
data.value: Chance that a bot in a town where a player stands reminds of an opened Blood Castle, Devil Square or Chaos Castle in the normal chat - once per town and opening, only a bot which meets the entry requirements. Independent of the /post chances. 0 = never.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_EventReminderLines_Description
data.value: Said in the normal chat by a bot in a town when an event entrance opened. Placeholders: {event}, {map}, {location}, {level}.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_RareDropChancePercent_Description
data.value: Chance that the nearest bot comments on an excellent or ancient item a player's kill dropped ("nice drop!"). 0 = never.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_NotableMonsterChancePercent_Description
data.value: Chance that a bot calls out a notable monster which appeared near it while a player sees it. 0 = never.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_NotableMonsterNumbers_Description
data.value: Comma-separated numbers of the monsters a bot calls out when they appear near it. By default the golden monsters, the Red Dragon and the White Wizard.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_RareDropLines_Description
data.value: Said by the nearest bot when a player's kill dropped an excellent or ancient item. Placeholders: {player}, {item}, {map}.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_NotableMonsterLines_Description
data.value: Said by a bot when a notable monster appeared near it. Placeholders: {monster}, {map}, {location}.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_FriendLines_Description
data.value: Said to a player the bot was in a party with before - instead of a greeting when the player enters the game, and instead of the party lines when the player invites it again. Remembered until the server restarts. Placeholders: {player}, {level}, {map}.

data.name: BotSayChatCommandPlugIn_Description
data.value: Handles the chat command '/botsay <bot> <text>'. A game master makes a server-side bot say the text in the normal chat, to the players who see it - e.g. for staged scenes of an event. Only bots, never a player's character.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_WingsChancePercent_Description
data.value: Chance that a bot comments on wings: its own new pair earned at a level milestone ("finally, my wings!"), or the wings a player next to it put on ("nice wings!"). 0 = never.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_OwnWingsLines_Description
data.value: Said by a bot which put on the new wings it earned at a level milestone, while a player sees it. Placeholders: {wings}, {level}, {map}.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_PlayerWingsLines_Description
data.value: Said by the nearest bot when a player put on wings - once per player and pair until the server restarts. Placeholders: {player}, {wings} (the player's), {map}.

data.name: BotChatConfiguration_WithoutWingsLines_Description
data.value: Said instead of a whisper reply with {wings} when the bot has no wings yet ("no wings yet, saving up"). Placeholders: {player}, {level}, {map}.

data.name: ShowWarpListAfterEnterWorldPlugIn_Name
data.value: Show the warp list after entering the game

data.name: ShowWarpListAfterEnterWorldPlugIn_Description
data.value: Tells the client which warps the player can select in the warp window, when the player enters the game.

data.name: TalismanOfResurrectionSpawnGatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Respawns a dead player at the place of its death, when it carries a Talisman of Resurrection, which is used up. It doesn't apply in mini games, duels and guild wars.

data.name: LuckyCoinFeaturePlugIn_Description
data.value: Players can register lucky coins at the NPC Delgado, or exchange 10, 20 or 30 of them for an item. The rewards of the exchange are configured here.

data.name: GladiatorsHonorConsumeHandlerPlugIn_Description
data.value: Applies the effect of the Gladiator's Honor, which can only be used in Vulcanus.

data.name: VulcanusExperiencePlugIn_Description
data.value: Increases the experience of players in Vulcanus by their Vulcanus experience rate, e.g. of the Gladiator's Honor.

data.name: WaitingItemsDeliveryPlugIn_Description
data.value: Puts the items which wait for space in the inventory of a character into it as soon as they fit there: when the character enters the game or opens the vault, and then periodically. When it's deactivated, the items keep waiting.

data.name: WaitingItemsChatCommandPlugIn_Description
data.value: Handles the chat command '/waiting'. Lists the items which wait for space in the inventory.

data.name: WaitingItemsDeliveryPlugInConfiguration_CheckInterval_Description
data.value: How often the waiting items are put into the inventories, as far as they fit there.

data.name: WaitingItemsDeliveryPlugInConfiguration_ItemsNamed_Description
data.value: The number of waiting items which are named, one per message, when the player is told about them when entering the game or opening the vault.

data.name: WaitingItemsCommandConfiguration_ItemsNamed_Description
data.value: The number of waiting items which are named, one per message.

data.name: BotMerchantPlugIn_Description
data.value: Lets server-side bots sell the goods of their personal store on the market map (Loren Market) for a while, then go back hunting.

data.name: BotMerchantConfiguration_MarketMapNumber_Description
data.value: The number of the map on which the bots open their stores (79 = Loren Market). The bots get there through its spawn gate, regardless of the warp list.

data.name: BotMerchantConfiguration_MaximumMerchants_Description
data.value: The maximum number of bots with an open store on the market at the same time, per game server.

data.name: BotMerchantConfiguration_MinimumLevel_Description
data.value: The minimum level of a bot to go to the market. The game allows a personal store from level 6.

data.name: BotMerchantConfiguration_MinimumGoodsToStart_Description
data.value: The minimum number of priced goods in the personal store of a bot to go to the market.

data.name: BotMerchantConfiguration_MinimumGoodsToStay_Description
data.value: When fewer goods are left, the bot closes its store and leaves the market early. 1 (default) = it stays as long as it has anything to sell.

data.name: BotMerchantConfiguration_MinimumShiftDuration_Description
data.value: The shortest stay on the market. The actual length is random between the minimum and the maximum.

data.name: BotMerchantConfiguration_MaximumShiftDuration_Description
data.value: The longest stay on the market.

data.name: BotMerchantConfiguration_LeaveWithoutSalesAfter_Description
data.value: After this time without a sale, the bot leaves the market before its shift is over and makes room for another one. Zero switches it off.

data.name: BotMerchantConfiguration_TimeBetweenShifts_Description
data.value: The time after a shift before the same bot goes to the market again.

data.name: BotMerchantConfiguration_StoreNames_Description
data.value: The names of the stores, separated by commas. Every shift draws one of them.

data.name: BotMerchantConfiguration_HighSetMinimumDropLevel_Description
data.value: The drop level from which an item counts as one of the higher sets. Normal items need it to be stocked; above it, ancient and the best excellent items cost more.

data.name: BotMerchantConfiguration_MinimumNormalItemLevel_Description
data.value: The minimum level (+) of a normal item of a higher set with luck to be stocked.

data.name: BotMerchantConfiguration_PriceSpreadPercent_Description
data.value: How far, up or down, a zen price may differ from the calculated one. It's drawn once, when the good goes into the store, and rounded to an amount a player would ask for, e.g. 800,000 or 5.5 million. Prices in jewels stay exact; 0 keeps all prices exact.

data.name: BotMerchantConfiguration_CheapCurrency_Description
data.value: The currency of the cheap goods (normal items, excellent items with only a cheap option): zen, bless, soul, chaos, life or creation.

data.name: BotMerchantConfiguration_CheapPrice_Description
data.value: The base price of the cheap goods.

data.name: BotMerchantConfiguration_CheapPricePerLevel_Description
data.value: The surcharge of the cheap goods per item level above +7.

data.name: BotMerchantConfiguration_CheapPricePerOption_Description
data.value: The surcharge of the cheap goods per +4 of the additional option. Fractions are summed up and rounded down.

data.name: BotMerchantConfiguration_MediumCurrency_Description
data.value: The currency of the medium goods (excellent items with one wanted option, without luck): zen, bless, soul, chaos, life or creation.

data.name: BotMerchantConfiguration_MediumPrice_Description
data.value: The base price of the medium goods.

data.name: BotMerchantConfiguration_MediumPricePerLevel_Description
data.value: The surcharge of the medium goods per item level above +7.

data.name: BotMerchantConfiguration_MediumPricePerOption_Description
data.value: The surcharge of the medium goods per +4 of the additional option. Fractions are summed up and rounded down, so 0.5 means one more per +8.

data.name: BotMerchantConfiguration_ExpensiveCurrency_Description
data.value: The currency of the expensive goods (ancient items, excellent items with two or more options or one wanted option and luck): zen, bless, soul, chaos, life or creation.

data.name: BotMerchantConfiguration_ExpensiveOneOptionPrice_Name
data.value: Expensive: one wanted option and luck

data.name: BotMerchantConfiguration_ExpensiveOneOptionPrice_Description
data.value: The base price of an excellent item with one wanted option and luck.

data.name: BotMerchantConfiguration_ExpensivePrice_Description
data.value: The base price of an excellent item with two options and of an ancient item.

data.name: BotMerchantConfiguration_ExpensiveThreeOptionsPrice_Description
data.value: The base price of an excellent item with three or more options.

data.name: BotMerchantConfiguration_ExpensivePricePerLevel_Description
data.value: The surcharge of the expensive goods per item level above +7.

data.name: BotMerchantConfiguration_ExpensivePricePerOption_Description
data.value: The surcharge of the expensive goods per +4 of the additional option. Fractions are summed up and rounded down, so 0.5 means one more per +8.

data.name: BotMerchantConfiguration_AncientLuckSurcharge_Description
data.value: The surcharge of an ancient item with luck.

data.name: BotMerchantConfiguration_HighSetSurcharge_Description
data.value: The surcharge of an ancient item, and of an excellent item with a wanted option, luck and an additional option, for every step of drop levels above the high set minimum drop level.

data.name: BotMerchantConfiguration_HighSetSurchargeDropLevels_Description
data.value: How many drop levels make one step of the higher set surcharge.
